title: More arithmetic needs organized data
purpose: Compare conceptual CPU vectors and cooperative GPU tile execution.
contract: SIMD lanes can hold several products; reduction order may change rounding.
GPU groups organize loads and reuse; not every product executes at once.
CPU/GPU explanation only; ENGINE-2 remains scalar, safe and single-threaded.
